sourceAssessment.finding: Default-hidden applies only to the three optional lunar optics. Existing serialized opacity values, DOM, filters, geometry, blend modes and opacity transitions remain unchanged. Positive values set inherit; only finite exact computed zero removes it. Invalid reads retain the fade.

Both ordinary and no-timetable writers use the helper. The source test covers fresh zero without a getter, exact existing sink strings, mid-fade retention/reversal, invalid reads, finite-zero retirement, rounded-to-zero input and reentry.

No scheduler is added. Pruning is revisited by the existing render path. A stopped simulated clock, hidden/offscreen state or no further render may leave an already opacity-zero effect inherited until the next paint; this bounds the optimization, not visible parity.
